name: Space Officer
description: There is a sharp divide in Aslan society between officers and crewmen; the officers are clearly of a higher caste. Male Space Officers are pilots, gunners, and leaders; females are navigators, engineers, and staff advisors.

commander.name: Commander
commander.description: You command one of your clan's mighty starships.

shipmaster.name: Shipmaster
shipmaster.description: You advise the captain on technical matters and administer a ship.

navigator.name: Navigator
navigator.description: You pilot a ship through jump space.

mishaps.1: Severely injured. Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: A disaster cripples your ship and you are blamed for this failing. Roll Advocate 8+ or Melee 8+ to challenge this decision. If you succeed, you may keep any Benefit rolls from this term.
mishaps.3: A shift in clan politics ruins your career. Lose SOC −2.
mishaps.4: Your vessel is destroyed in battle. Gain the foe who defeated you as a Rival.
mishaps.5: You are captured by a rival clan and ransomed back but the disgrace ends your career. Gain a Contact in the rival clan.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: Your ship is attacked by pirates. Roll Tactics 8+ or Engineer 8+. If you succeed, you drive off the attackers and gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll. If you fail, the pirates steal your cargo. Lose all Benefit rolls from this term and gain the pirate captain as an Enemy.
events.4: You have the opportunity to smuggle illegal goods. If you accept, roll Deception 8+. Succeed and gain 6 Benefit rolls. Fail and you are ejected from this career and drop to SOC 2.
events.5: You spend time in alien space. Gain one level of Tolerance 1, Diplomat 1, Language 1 or Science 1.
events.6: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Aslan Life Events table.
events.8: You have the opportunity to establish a landhold in your name. Gain TER +2.
events.9: Your clan goes to war with another clan and your vessel attacks one of their worlds. If you drive the colonists offworld with vicious tactics, gain TER +2 but lose SOC −2.
events.10: You are challenged to a duel by a rival. If you refuse, you lose SOC −1D. Accept, and roll Melee 8+. If you fail, you lose all Benefits from this term. Succeed and gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.
events.11: You befriend an old Aslan admiral. Either gain Tactics (Naval) 1 or DM+4 to any advancement roll thanks to their aid.
events.12: Your efforts strike a great blow for your clan. You are automatically promoted.

mustering_dm_notes: DM+1 if SOC 9+. DM+1 when rolling on Benefits if Male.
